$comment: The schemas at the top of specs/src's areas that the suites read: the services' configuration documents and health answers, Archivist's anchored-text entry, and the schemas of the tables the harness reads (harness/spec.ts readTable). Each is found by its name at the top of an area; the gateway's document lists none of them. harness/services-document.ts writes harness/generated/services.openapi.json from this list: openapi-typescript types it (harness/generated/services-types.ts), and the harness's servicesSpec() validates against it.
